boundaries.contract: Plugin discovery and repository content cannot invoke a provider or register a Stop-event execution path.

All current numeric, enum, provider and lifecycle inputs are validated before arithmetic, path selection, status interpretation, process launch or state mutation. `$HOME/.claude/council-policy.json` is the sole authority for allow|strict|deny; repository policy is ignored, deny blocks all execution, and strict permits only explicit manual invocation.
Legacy job states are queued, running, completed, failed, timed-out or cancelled; terminal states are immutable and status updates are atomic. Kernel quorum states remain outside Stage 1.
Release mutation is allowed only when origin is AnnasCookies/claude-council, upstream is hex/claude-council, the upstream MIT licence is retained and explicit attribution exists.
Tracked and packaged public content contains no credential value or private identity, project, record, charter or ledger artefact; public placeholder names remain allowed.

invariants: No repository hook or configuration starts council execution.
No terminal callback can replace an earlier terminal state.
No untrusted value is interpreted as shell or arithmetic syntax.
No release command mutates the repository before ownership checks pass.
The new Bun standing-council core is outside Stage 1.
risks: Portable atomic state mutation across macOS and Linux shell environments.
False-positive privacy scanning of public examples and environment-variable names.
Historical documentation must not be rewritten as if the Stop gate never existed.
